summary: The Boston City Council Committee on Public Safety and Security held a hearing regarding a regional homeland security grant to fund counterterrorism, emergency management, and public safety initiatives across the region [01:53], [03:27]. Public safety officials explained how the funds support emergency response equipment, intelligence analysts, real-time crime center operations, and interagency coordination [15:40], [23:29], [31:43], [41:47]. Council members pressed officials with questions regarding gang database criteria, data sharing with federal law enforcement and immigration agencies, equipment procurement timelines, and civil liberties protections [07:48], [55:45], [1:27:01], [1:52:02], [2:09:22]. Residents and community organization representatives provided public testimony voicing opposition to the grant due to concerns over municipal surveillance, racial profiling, and transparency [2:55:59], [3:02:07], [3:18:06], [3:46:46]. No formal votes or decisions were taken during the hearing [3:50:18].
